summary: Split hero after IRIS Software. Dark ground: a short eyebrow, a large headline whose *accent* part is set in the brand colour, the lead and optional buttons on the left; on the right one person photo on a rounded brand-colour panel, with 2 or 3 small white cards over its edges, each naming a real service line with an icon and a small drawn mark (bar chart, tick or list lines). Under the copy a finder bar straddles the hero's lower edge: 2 or 3 labelled dropdowns (for example Industry, Company size, Looking for) whose options each jump to a section of the page, and a search button that opens the most specific choice. The panel rises, the cards pop in and their marks draw once; no loops. Suits multi-service companies whose visitors arrive with different needs.

hint.default: Pick an option in one of the lists first.
